purpose: Complete phase-specific admission binding proposal; preserves existing runtime predicates rather than pretending structural JSON Schema can replace authentication, coercion or digest comparisons.
direction: Producer and phase-specific Admission contracts separated by user instruction on 2026-10-17.

interpretation.fieldPolicies: Every root producer field is accounted for per boundary. Nested checked members and context dependencies are specified by predicates and exact named current validators. Extra fields retain current ignored semantics unless the listed validator closes the object.
interpretation.notAJSONSchemaReplacement: These declarative admission obligations include existing code predicates, not a new accepting runtime validator or a claim of all JavaScript coercions being JSON Schema.
interpretation.internalStates: initial canary/envelope construction and primitive test-only artifact validation are not production producer/authority variants.
interpretation.failureReports: Canary SDK/selected failure reports remain complete producer variants but are rejected by both successful-canary admission boundaries.
interpretation.maraca: Only complete tune-produced config/report phases are described as such. Permissive factory return type correction remains a separate public API task; no full factory authority inferred.
